reviews.text: A warm-hearted place to go :)

We have been going to CatVet for several years, but our most recent experiences were a real disappointment.

My cat was diagnosed with diabetes. Within a short period of time, three visits cost over €900. For treatments this expensive, you should expect clear and expert care and guidance.

During the visits, we received conflicting instructions about diabetes treatment and monitoring. We were ordered to have check-ups every 1–2 weeks, with one visit costing around €250.

As a first-time user of insulin, the practical guidance I received was lacking, my questions were not answered, and the customer service was unnecessarily pushy.

The continuity of medication was also particularly worrying. An insulin prescription had not been written even after several visits. When I called the clinic about the matter, I was promised that the matter would be taken care of and that I would be called back. However, no contact was made and the promised prescription was not written. However, it was about necessary medication for an animal with diabetes.

I also found the situation very unpleasant, in which I was already tearful and worried about my cat's condition at the reception and asked about the costs of treatment. The discussion brought up the option of not treating and euthanasia, even though I was looking for humane alternatives. In this situation, I would have missed empathy and concrete alternatives. I had to go and find a solution myself.

In addition, there were ambiguities during the visits regarding the examinations and billing. I sent a written complaint to CatVet about the whole thing. We received one response, but the matter was not resolved or refunded, and no further clarification was responded to.

Overall, unfortunately, it was no longer just a single bad customer service experience. When it comes to a chronic illness, treatment instructions, medication and monitoring should form a safe and consistent whole.

After these experiences, we moved our cat's treatment elsewhere and the price was almost 3 times cheaper and better on top of that.
Later we also learned that our cat's diabetes had not been treated properly.

After years of being a customer, this is a very unfortunate outcome, but definitely the only right one and saved the cat and us financially.

The best cat expertise in the country

If you have a cat, this is the vet for you. The facility is designed to support your cat's comfort, through the design of the environment (no stress from dogs barking, calm and quiet places to sit, and cat carrier holding racks in the waiting room and lobby), to the care and attention of the staff (who can predict and appropriately and gently handle cats and their reactions to the exam and treatment exercises), to the consideration of medications and medication delivery methods (ointments, oral pills or liquids, or injections)taking into account the unique reactions cats have to these treatments. The staff genuinely care to have good relations with your furry family members and helping to the best of their ability that you get to enjoy your cat's companionship through good health as long as possible. So grateful to this veterinary clinic!

The best cat care place I know, used as a cat care place for Vihtori his entire life. The service and care have always been friendly, professional and good, I also received help over the phone when needed. The staff knows how to handle cats well and the prices for procedures have remained reasonable. Today, my teeth were treated again, and the first tooth extractions were also done. I received good aftercare advice both verbally and in writing from the doctor and nurse. A positive surprise was also that I could buy painkillers right away and did not have to go to the pharmacy. The new premises along Huopalahdentie are good and comfortable, and it is easy to park the car. I can warmly recommend this place.
